question: Select the most appropriate answer for blank 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"assist."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Assist"** means to help or support someone in achieving something. (सहायता करना) • **Example**:* I will **assist**__ you in completing the project on time.* • It is the most appropriate answer for the blank, as the other options do not fit the context of the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 1. • **Correct passage**: Summer camp is a terrific idea used primarily by schools to __**assist**__ pupils to acquire and master new skills. It is an ______ (2) ______ outdoor activity. Many parents offer to enroll their kids in summer camps so they can participate in ______ (3) ______ activities, discover their talents and passions, and broaden their horizons. Summer camps are ______ (4) ______ for all children for ten to fifteen days by various schools or other organisations. These summer camps ______ (5) ______ entertaining educational activities like fitness classes, hobby improvement classes, learning lectures, sports activities, musical performances, etc. The pupils' general development and growth are benefitted from these summer camps.​ **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "accelerate,"** means to speed up or increase the rate of something. (गति का बढ़ना, किसी वस्‍तु, घटना आदि की गति को बढ़ाना) • **Option 3, "examine,"** means to inspect or scrutinize something closely. (बहुत सावधानी से किसी विषय, धारणा आदि पर विचार करना) • **Option 4,** **"hinder" **means to create obstacles or difficulties for someone or something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए कठिनाई पैदा करना, किसी के काम में बाधा डालना) 3e:Teb5, The correct answer is** "organised."**
